# Closeta

> Closeta is a wardrobe organizer and outfit planner app for iPhone and iPad. It helps people organize their closet with photos, build and save outfits, plan what to wear on a calendar, and automatically generate packing lists for trips. It is free to download, works offline, and stores wardrobe data on-device rather than in a mandatory cloud account.

Closeta is developed by Deep Saha and available on the Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/outfit-maker-closet-closeta/id6760401759

## What Closeta does

- Digital wardrobe organizer: catalog tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, outerwear and accessories with photos, category, color, season and occasion tags.
- Outfit builder: combine clothing pieces into complete outfits and save them as a personal lookbook.
- Outfit discovery: swipe through auto-generated combinations from your own wardrobe.
- Outfit planner calendar: schedule outfits to specific dates, add occasion notes, track planning insights.
- Trip packing list generator: assign outfits to each day of a trip and get an automatic packing list built from the pieces used.
- Privacy-first: wardrobe photos and data are stored locally on the user's device; not sold or shared.

## Who it's for

Students planning daily outfits, professionals planning workwear, travelers organizing packing lists, people building a capsule wardrobe, and anyone who wants a faster way to decide what to wear.

## Pricing

Free to download with core features included. Optional Premium subscription: monthly and yearly plans, billed through the Apple App Store.
